name: Salisha Thomas: The Possibility Project
description: NEW YORK, NY Broadway star and acclaimed vocalist Salisha Thomas will bring The Possibility Project to Birdland Jazz Club on Monday, November 2 at 7:00 PM. An intimate evening of music, storytelling, and inspiration, The Possibility Project traces Thomass journey from Disney to Broadway and beyond through the songs, artists, and experiences that have helped shape her life and career.Featuring beloved music associated with Carole King, Lena Horne, and other legendary artists, the evening combines personal stories with songs that celebrate ambition, resilience, reinvention, and the unexpected turns that can lead to extraordinary places. At the heart of The Possibility Project is a simple idea: the life youre dreaming about may be closer than you think. Salisha Thomas is a Broadway actress, singer, producer, author, and host. She made her Broadway debut in Beautiful: The Carole King Musical before starring in Once Upon a One More Time. She has performed alongside Hugh Jackman at Radio City Music Hall, the Hollywood Bowl, and arenas across North America. Thomas is also the author of Why Be a 9 When You Can Be a 10 and the creator and host of The Salisha Show podcast, where she brings her trademark curiosity and enthusiasm to conversations about creativity, career, and living life to its fullest potential.
why: Broadway vocalist Salisha Thomas's storytelling show at Birdland.

description: VIP experience includes: meet and greet and champagne TCB presents: CODE RED Code Red: Industry Night Weekly on Monday Doors 7:30pm Guest Opening Act 8pm Main Show featuring The Cabaret Burlesque 8:30 - 10:30pm Music and Bar until 1am Contact @thecabaretburlesque on instagram to APPLY to perform as an Opening Act An Industry Night where your wildest fantasies just might come true.
